description: Search Sendora's guides, API reference, error codes and the SDKs' READMEs. Use it before writing code against either SDK or the HTTP API, and whenever an error code or a limit needs explaining. Answers the best-matching sections with their document's uri; read the whole document with read_doc.

query.description: Words to look for, such as "verify webhook signature" or an error code such as recipient_suppressed.

name: search_docs

results.description: The best-matching sections, the best first.

section.description: The heading of the section that matched.

snippet.description: The words around the match, marked where they are cut.

uri.description: The document to read with read_doc.

title: Search the Sendora docs
